title: The edge of the asymptotic spectrum of tensors
summary: Strassen founded the theory of the asymptotic spectrum of tensors to study the complexity of matrix multiplication. A central challenge in this theory is to explicitly construct new spectral points. In Crelle 1991, Strassen proposed the upper support functionals $ζ^θ$ as candidate spectral points, where $θ$ ranges over a triangle $Θ$.
